channel.title: Governance Digest: optimism
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: Proposal for Sequencer Fee Rebates on OP Mainnet (optimism)
item.description: The Optimism Foundation asks to rebate part of OP Mainnet sequencer fees to select partners, for activity those partners bring, paid in ETH fee revenue rather than OP.

item.title: Maintenance Upgrade Proposal: OP Mainnet Proposer Rotation (optimism)
item.description: OP Labs proposes rotating the proposer key on OP Mainnet's permissioned fallback dispute game to new OP Enterprise infrastructure; it passes unless vetoed during a one-week window.
